description: The backrooms spread throughout your world.

releases.notes: Literally changed one line to make it work in single player!

Added more commands and room features. Added more config as well allowing for greater customization.
Significant changes are:
- Room blocking: Cuts big rooms into several smaller, making bigger rooms generate much faster. (PERFORMANCE IMPACT!)
- Connecting rooms: Walls that have rooms right next to them will now not generate, making the structure more cohesive.
- Room features config: Most room features blocks can now be configured in the config.

Config and Commands:

Key: [/] changed, [+] added, [-] removed, [o] unchanged

All Commands:
[o] `/spreadrooms start`
[/] `/spreadrooms stop`
[+] `/spreadrooms reload`
[+] `/spreadrooms reset`
[/] `/spreadrooms debug rooms_ticking`
[/] `/spreadrooms debug rooms_count`

All config:
[o] `areaFromCenter` Integer
[o] `timeToSpread` Integer
[/] `timeToSpreadVariation` Integer
[o] `timedSpread` Boolean
[+] `strictGeneration` Boolean
[+] `generateOnPlane` Boolean
[+] `connectRooms` Boolean
[o] `maxGenRooms` Integer
[o] `defaultRoomSize` Size
[+] `sizeVariation` Size
[+] `sizeVariationShift` Size
[+] `sizeVariationFactor` Size
[+] `roomBlocking` Boolean
[+] `maxRoomSize` Size
[+++] `featureStates` Array of Blocks

The initial release. Still in alpha. Currently the mod generates the 'backrooms' in Minecraft.
**Its only required to be on the server.**
Use `/spreadrooms start` to start the mod (you need operator permissions). It WILL create a 200 block worldborder and the backrooms starts on the bottom southwest corner of the world.

### Commands:
`/spreadrooms start` (starts the spread)
`/spreadrooms stop` (stop the spread... may require a restart of the server before you can start again?)
`/spreadrooms rooms_count` (lists how many rooms are being created, are queued for creation, and have been created)
`/spreadrooms rooms_ticking` (gives a huge list of all the ticking rooms and their properties)

### Config Options: (in  /config/spreadrooms.json after launch)
`areaFromCenter` (sets the worldborder size and where the rooms spawn)
`timeToSpread` (ticks to spread)
`timeToSpreadVariation` (variation when spreading... kinda useless)
`timedSpread` (toggles the timed spread, which is defined by the two preceding options. otherwise its every tick)
`maxGenRooms` (maximum amount of rooms that can generate at once, **HEAVY PERFORMANCE IMPACT!**)
`defaultRoomSize` (values x, y, and z define the default room size)

### Warning
This can be very intensive on the server and may take a long time to fully spread!
